Original detail _orderTotal fallback is a protected calculation. Raw total/subtotals/lines need honest optional formatting; do not change its arithmetic or promote missing numeric DTO defaults to confirmed values.
Detail timeline fallback is a current state summary, not dated historical events. Preserve canonical received timeline and label fallback honestly.

Detail shipping provider-mode badge is hardcoded sandbox. Existing GET /shipping-labels/provider-mode supplies provider_mode and capabilities; use exact supported SDK/read path if available, otherwise mark not checked. No credential or carrier policy edits.

Return list currently reads persistent service rows directly and has no generation/query presentation ownership. Returned rows must match captured current store/query before presentation. Existing read API supplies exact count/page/limit, so pagination can be exposed by narrow presentation metadata without changing requests.

ReturnService is already request-context-bound for commands and completion proof; preserve all command bodies. MerchantReturn.refundAmount missing-to-zero getter must remain untouched; use toJson raw nullability for displayed amount instead.
